coverage_note: Domains are chosen to cover the STATE SPACE, not merely to be real captures: a corpus missing a state cannot detect a regression in it. TestGoldenFixtureStateCoverage enforces the states listed there.
subject_constraint: Fixture subjects must be large public institutions or companies. These captures are published in an immutable DOI-bearing Zenodo deposit; freezing a private party's spoofability into a permanent public archive is not licensed by the state-coverage requirement. If only a private domain exhibits a needed state, leave it uncovered by live capture and unit-test the state directly. See scripts/refresh-golden-fixtures.sh.
